notes.title: New patch available!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42259819/374fa21886a7143f7144a79ca920bcddf2a1b349.jpg[/img]

Hi everyone!

A new patch is available on PCs and consoles. Changelog below:[list]
[*] Adjusted picture preview in the Behind the Scenes menu
[*] Button Icons adjusted in several scenes
[*] Turkish font changed to support all special characters
[*] Fixed visibility of toys in Peter's bedroom scene
[*] Adjusted position of Sam's hands in Peter's study scene
[*] Fixed red light in the Train Cabin scene, so it is properly synched now
[*] Several animations were adjusted
[*] Additional minor bug fixes
[/list]

Take care,
11 bit studios

notes.title: South of the Circle | Release Date Announcement
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30442987/60809c38763364e2dfe9f888a62bb561a50ca63c.jpg[/img]

Hello everyone!

Watch the latest trailer and have a glimpse of the engaging cinematic story contrasting the freezing cold of Antarctica with the burning desire to keep our promises in the upcoming game from State of Play and 11 bit studios. 
[previewyoutube=0iWsdsyjv7c;full][/previewyoutube]

South of the Circle is coming on August 3. Add the game to your wishlist and don't miss any future updates:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1811040/South_of_the_Circle/

If you've enjoyed [b]Frostpunk[/b] and especially its outstanding soundtrack then you should definitely check out Circles EP. It's a fruitful result of a powerful collaboration of the Frostpunk OST composer and the creator of the South of the Circle OST. Two amazing artists covered each other's music  blending the original mood with the new sensibility. 

[b]Listen to Circles EP here:[/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2052810/Circles_EP_South_of_the_Circle_Edition/


Take care,
11 bit studios
